description: This file defines a React component called SplitView that creates a resizable split view layout, supporting both vertical and horizontal orientations. It manages sidebar size state, resizing interactions, and applies appropriate styles. It also imports utility hooks and styles, and exports the component for use in the project.

methods.name: SplitView
methods.description: React functional component providing a resizable split view with sidebar and main content areas, supporting both vertical and horizontal orientations.
